machine: local Apple M5 Pro laptop (Darwin 25.6.0, arm64, 48 GB), not a cloud VM
shared_load_note: other agents' jobs (cube-and-conquer workers, other CaDiCaL runs, Lean builds) ran on the same machine at the same time; load average was 80-95 on 15 cores during the main run, so all wall times are inflated by contention
